item.question: What is the purpose of using latent factors in feature selection for multiclass classification?
item.answer: Latent factors are used to represent each class separately, allowing for tailored feature selection based on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for each class. This approach facilitates class incremental learning and ensures that the method is theoretically grounded rather than heuristic.
